# PPPlayer

> A free, open-source media player. No account. No subscription. Just play.

PPPlayer is a cross-platform media player app available on macOS, Android (APK), iOS (TestFlight), and Windows. It lets users discover media, stream audio and video tracks, and explore artists — without requiring an account or subscription. The app is fully open-source under a permissive license and welcomes contributions.

## Key Information

- **Website**: https://ppplayer.com
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/ppplayer-labs/app
- **GitHub Organization**: https://github.com/ppplayer-labs
- **License**: MIT — https://github.com/ppplayer-labs/ppplayer/blob/main/LICENSE
- **Current version**: See latest release on GitHub
- **Built with**: Flutter (Dart), targeting macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, and Linux.
- **Detailed Documentation**: See [llms-full.txt](https://ppplayer.com/llms-full.txt) for comprehensive details on features, language support, and architecture.

- **iOS**: https://apps.apple.com/app/ppplayer (Configured, but pending public release)
- **Linux**: Experimental (see download page)

## Features

- Stream and discover audio and video without an account
- YouTube-powered playback via an embedded iframe bridge
- Local video playback with advanced subtitle support
- Network streaming and M3U playlist parsing
- Artist radio and discovery mode
- Queue management, playlist support, and queue exports
- Background audio playback on all platforms
- Open-source — inspect, fork, and contribute freely

## Contributing

- **Issues & Bug Reports**: https://github.com/ppplayer-labs/app/issues

## Localization

The website and app maintain complete structural and translation parity across 38 corresponding locales, including English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, Turkish, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and Chinese among others. The only remaining untranslated terms are intentional cross-language branding or shared UI vocabulary. The 38 languages are fully released and supported in the latest version of the app.
